Definition: Etsjon-Geber, a place on the Red Sea
BiblicalUsage: Ezion-geber = "backbone of a man"; 1) the last station during the exodus of the Israelites before they came to the wilderness of Zin; located near Elath at the head of the Gulf of Akaba
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
